calls.title: SEO edits on PO post
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to balance strong SEO practices with the goal of maintaining appeal to their data science readership. Incorporating Jason's SEO feedback resulted in improved content quality while avoiding overly SEO-heavy language. They also preferred the term 'experimentation' over 'A/B testing' to position the brand as leaders in innovation, although they recognized the need for SEO concessions. Google Docs was chosen as the main collaboration tool despite its limitations, facilitating efficient content editing. The article is near completion, pending final revisions and image adjustments. Additionally, guidelines for image sizing were established to maintain professional aesthetics. The collaborative environment fostered trust and openness, supporting high-quality content production.
calls.keywords: SEO content, experimentation leadership, AB testing, Google Docs collaboration, image sizing, blog publishing
